name: Post-Flood Building Damage Assessment Benchmark
description: A benchmarking suite to evaluate attention mechanisms and consistency-regularized semi-supervised learning methods for assessing building damage after floods from imagery.
evaluation_method: F1 (for classification), Intersection-over-Union / mIoU (for segmentation), and accuracy (task-dependent)
general_score_metric: F1 (primary for damage classification) and mIoU (primary for segmentation)
reputation: A recent, task-focused benchmark for post-flood building damage assessment that is gaining attention in remote sensing / disaster-response ML research but has limited widespread adoption so far.
notes: Domain-specific remote sensing benchmark (non-LLM); potential label noise and class imbalance; may contain multi-sensor imagery; semi-supervised and attention-method emphasis—newer dataset with limited historical baselines.
